category_edits.rationale: Test exponent 0.40 instead of 0.50 for normalized training-frequency features across all four datasets, increasing attenuation of middle-frequency history items. Counts remain training-only, unseen-item features remain zero, and the existing checkpoint buffer preserves predictor consistency. Embeddings, causal backbone, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

change_summary: Change only the training-frequency feature exponent from 0.50 to 0.40 for all four category models.
